label: coverage
command:
import csv
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root=Path('.')
evidence=root/'experiments/results/remaining_kitti_coverage'
summary=json.loads((evidence/'summary.json').read_text())
with (root/'docs/assets/paper/paper_ratio_table.csv').open() as f:
    table=list(csv.DictReader(f))
source_commit=summary['input_commit']
counts={}
for method,info in summary['methods'].items():
    selected=[row for row in table if row['method']==method]
    assert len(selected)==len(info['rows'])
    for row in info['rows']:
        seq=row['sequence']
        aggregate=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',source_commit+':'+row['aggregate']]))
        variant=next(v for v in aggregate['variants'] if v['id']==info['variant'])
        assert variant['args']==info['args']
        assert 'no gt seed' in variant['note'].lower()
        with (root/f'experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_{seq}_full_gt.csv').open() as f:
            expected=sum(1 for _ in csv.DictReader(f))
        assert variant['frames']==expected
        t=next(t for t in selected if t['sequence']==seq)
        assert t['repo_metric']=='kitti_rte' and t['repo_best_variant']==info['variant']
        assert int(t['repo_pool_size'])>=1 and int(t['selected_from_n'])>=1
        selected_aggregate=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',source_commit+':'+t['repo_best_aggregate']]))
        selected_variant=next(v for v in selected_aggregate['variants'] if v['id']==info['variant'])
        assert selected_variant['args']==info['args']
        assert t['repo_best_rpe_pct']==f"{row['fixed_rte_pct']:.3f}"
        assert t['repo_best_ratio']==f"{row['fixed_ratio']:.2f}"
        if row['above_twice_paper']:
            assert (root/row['diagnostics_path']).is_file()
        if seq not in info['reused_sequences']:
            run=root/'experiments/results/runs'/Path(row['aggregate']).stem/info['variant']
            s=json.loads((run/'summary.json').read_text())
            assert s['num_frames']==s['total_pcd_frames']==s['used_gt_pose_count']==expected
    counts[method]={'full_sequences':len(selected),'frames':[r['frames'] for r in info['rows']],
                    'above_twice_paper':info['above_twice_paper']}
old=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','5d817b5ada87f61dcbbf3299fd3d055c035f3d62:evaluation/data/paper_reported_numbers.json']))
new=json.loads((root/'evaluation/data/paper_reported_numbers.json').read_text())
for method in old['methods']:
    assert old['methods'][method].get('reported_values')==new['methods'][method].get('reported_values')
    assert old['methods'][method].get('reported_source')==new['methods'][method].get('reported_source')
history=json.loads((evidence/'historical_aggregate_sha256.json').read_text())
for path,value in history['sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==value
for seq in ['01','02','03','04','05','06','08','09','10']:
    assert json.loads((evidence/f'seq_{seq}_complete.json').read_text())['scans_deleted']
for name in ['controller_exit.json']:
    assert json.loads((evidence/name).read_text())['exit_code']==0
assert all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in json.loads((evidence/'import_commands.json').read_text()))
assert all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in json.loads((evidence/'regeneration_commands.json').read_text()))
print(json.dumps({'methods':counts,'historical_aggregates_unchanged':len(history['sha256']),
                  'paper_reference_values_and_sources_unchanged':True},indent=2))

# Additional checks for the frozen source, manifests and handwritten overview rows.
plan=json.loads((root/'experiments/kitti_remaining_fixed_coverage_plan.json').read_text())
environment=json.loads((evidence/'environment.json').read_text())
assert environment['evaluator_git_commit']=='5d817b5ada87f61dcbbf3299fd3d055c035f3d62'
new_runs=0
for config in plan['methods']:
    name=config['method']; info=summary['methods'][name]
    original=json.loads((root/config['source_manifest']).read_text())
    frozen=next(v for v in original['variants'] if v['id']==config['variant'])
    assert frozen['args']==info['args']==config['args']
    for seq in config['new_sequences']:
        stem=f'{name}_kitti_seq_{seq}_full_paper_comp_matrix'
        manifest=json.loads((root/'experiments'/f'{stem}.json').read_text())
        assert manifest['variants']==[frozen]
        run=root/'experiments/results/runs'/stem/config['variant']
        recorded=json.loads((run/'summary.json').read_text())
        assert recorded['evaluator_git_commit']==environment['evaluator_git_commit']
        assert recorded['gt_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((root/manifest['problem']['dataset']['gt_csv']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        assert len((run/'trajectory_kitti.txt').read_text().splitlines())==recorded['num_frames']
        assert len((run/'evaluated_gt_kitti.txt').read_text().splitlines())==recorded['num_frames']
        commands=json.loads((evidence/f'seq_{seq}_{name}_commands.json').read_text())
        assert all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in commands)
        new_runs+=1
    for doc in ['README.md','docs/roadmap.md','docs/paper_claim.md']:
        text=(root/doc).read_text()
        if doc=='README.md':text=text[text.index('### Paper-number check'):]
        line=next(line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('|') and (f'| {info["label"]} |' in line or f'| {info["label"]} (' in line))
        assert f'{info["fixed_geometric_mean_ratio"]:.2f}x' in line,(doc,name)
    readme=(root/'papers'/name/'README.md').read_text()
    assert readme.count('<!-- FIXED-KITTI-RESULTS:START -->')==1
    for row in info['rows']:
        if row['above_twice_paper']:
            assert f"{row['fixed_ratio']:.2f}x" in readme
            assert row['diagnostics_path'] in readme
assert new_runs==26
assert len(summary['methods']['l_lo']['rows'])==10
assert 'Completed: A-LOAM, LF-GICP, L-LO and Quadric-LO' in (root/'docs/roadmap.md').read_text()
for name in ['postbuild_checks.json','final_checks.json']:
    assert all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in json.loads((evidence/'checks'/name).read_text())['checks'])
print(json.dumps({'new_full_runs':new_runs,'fixed_configurations_and_provenance_checked':True,'overview_means_match_committed_evidence':True},indent=2))

label: all-overview-unrounded-ratios
command:
import collections
import csv
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root=Path('.')
evidence=root/'experiments/results/remaining_kitti_coverage'
summary=json.loads((evidence/'summary.json').read_text())
commit=summary['input_commit']
paper=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',commit+':evaluation/data/paper_reported_numbers.json']))['methods']
labels={'aloam':'A-LOAM','ct_icp':'CT-ICP','dilo':'DiLO','elo':'ELO','imls_slam':'IMLS-SLAM','inten_loam':'InTEn-LOAM','kiss_icp':'KISS-ICP','l_lo':'L-LO','lf_gicp':'LF-GICP','litamin2':'LiTAMIN2','mesh_loam':'Mesh-LOAM','mulls':'MULLS','quadric_lo':'Quadric-LO','suma':'SuMa'}
groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
with (root/'docs/assets/paper/paper_ratio_table.csv').open() as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        aggregate=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',commit+':'+row['repo_best_aggregate']]))
        value=next(v for v in aggregate['variants'] if v['id']==row['repo_best_variant'])['kitti_rte_trans_pct']
        reference=paper[row['method']]['reported_values']['kitti_'+row['sequence']]
        groups[row['method']].append({'sequence':row['sequence'],'aggregate':row['repo_best_aggregate'],'variant':row['repo_best_variant'],'repo_rte_pct':value,'paper_rte_pct':reference,'ratio':value/reference})
report={'input_commit':commit,'rounding':'Geometric mean of unrounded committed RTE ratios, then round once for display.','methods':{}}
for name,rows in groups.items():
    mean=math.exp(sum(math.log(r['ratio']) for r in rows)/len(rows))
    for file in ['README.md','docs/roadmap.md','docs/paper_claim.md']:
        text=(root/file).read_text()
        if file=='README.md':text=text[text.index('### Paper-number check'):]
        label=labels[name]
        line=next(v for v in text.splitlines() if v.startswith('|') and ('| '+label+' |' in v or '| '+label+' (' in v))
        assert f'{mean:.2f}x' in line,(name,file,mean,line)
    report['methods'][name]={'geometric_mean_ratio':mean,'display_ratio':f'{mean:.2f}x','rows':rows}
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
